answers.reason: Status values are shown as text (Active, Invited) on colored badges; meaning is not conveyed by color alone.
Control boundaries and icons are clearly visible: '···' action buttons have sufficient contrast in light and dark modes; reorder icons are visible; focus ring is clear and contrasting.
Visible text '···' matches screen reader announcement; reorder buttons are icon-only and exempt from this criterion.
All text is fully visible: names, roles, and status labels are not cut off or truncated.
In Default focused screenshot, the '···' button has a prominent blue outline clearly indicating focus.
